title: Do not build the unknown from worry
meaning: Losing familiar certainty can feel difficult for your union, while attention helps distinguish newly visible facts from anxious guesses.
text: In the overall energy field of your union, a newly discovered crack may stir more feeling than you can immediately explain. In the physical position, the High Priestess leaves room for observation: not everything requires instant intervention. In energy, the Tower directs effort towards examining what no longer withstands scrutiny, such as a familiar explanation or shared assumption. In emotions, the Moon conveys uncertainty after a discovery. Imagination keeps filling out the picture, and the unknown readily acquires an anxious colouring. Neither the intensity of feeling nor matching guesses proves their accuracy.

Imagine rereading the terms of a subscription you arranged some time ago and finding an unexpected clause. At first, it seems that your whole spending plan must change, although the consequences remain unclear. Together, you distinguish what the agreement says from what you have imagined. **After an unwelcome discovery, your union benefits from clarity about the limits of what is known.** This does not remove every feeling, but it gives you one subject to discuss instead of two expanding versions of the future.

The difficulty appears if every doubt becomes another crack in your shared arrangements. You want to check everything at once, and each gap suggests a hidden threat. Trying to regain confidence, you intensify each other’s worry. Observation becomes a search for reasons to distrust. Acknowledging an incomplete picture can be more honest than filling it with fear.
